newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures end lower in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures end lower in lackluster trade.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled down near the day's lows in thin, largely rangebound and featureless trading.
"We are entering a holiday market already," a trader said.
There was little fresh news to trade on, and follow through selling from Friday was also noted, along with the inability of early trade buying to avoid a negative close.
March cotton went out 0.25 cent weaker at 75.85 cents per pound, traded 76.17 to 75.70 cents.
Volume was modest at an estimated 4,000 lots compared to Friday's official 5,490 lots.
